<style>

  --ink: #1f2933; --muted: #56606c; --rule: #e3e6ea; --rule-strong: #aab1ba;
  color: var(--ink);
  font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
}
#needle h2 { font-size: 1.15rem; margin: 2.25rem 0 .6rem; font-weight: 600; }

#needle .map-tip[hidden] { display: none; }

  <h2>Early electorate</h2>

  <h2>Method note</h2>
  <div class="method">
    <p>On this page, I show model estimates of win likelihood. This is <em>not</em> an official result. The model is a precinct-level estimate of how many votes remain and how they might split. I aggregate this up to a district-wide estimate.</p>
    <p>I start with county reports of absentee ballots from mail and early in-person vote. These historically lean Democratic, so early counts tend to lean towards Democrats. The model considers early and Election Day votes separately, and expects a similar partisan difference between these votes as 2024, when Election Day votes leaned Republican. Before votes are counted, the estimate works off an adjusted polling average and the number of absentee ballots received by each precinct and early-voting site. For a benchmark, I model how each county would vote in a tied race. This starts with 2024 results at the precinct level, split into Election Day, early in-person, mail and provisional votes, and applies a uniform swing. Counted votes are compared by type, so early vote is compared to early vote benchmarks. Groups show as 'too early' until at least 10 percent of expected votes have been counted, and as running ahead of benchmarks only when performances exceed 3 point differences overall.</p>
    <p>Results are unofficial vote counts, from the North Carolina State Board of Elections. The page checks for new data every minute, but the data file may lag by a few minutes.</p>
    <p><a id="repo-link" href="#">Code and data</a></p>
  </div>

  <noscript><p>This page needs JavaScript to load the live data.</p></noscript>
</div>

<script>
(function () {
  "use strict";

  const DATA_URL = "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/zacharylhertz/needle-nc01/main/data/live/state.json";
  const REPO_URL = "https://github.com/zacharylhertz/needle-nc01";
  const POLL_MS = 60000;
  const FETCH_TIMEOUT_MS = 20000;
  const POLLS_CLOSE = Date.parse("2026-11-03T19:30:00-05:00");
  // During a count, warn if the file itself stops refreshing (for example the pipeline has died).
  const PAGE_STALE_MS = 15 * 60000;
  const COLORS = { D: "#1171B9", R: "#EB2326", L: "#AB8D5F" };
  const PARTY_NAMES = { DEM: "Democrat", REP: "Republican", LIB: "Libertarian" };
  const INCUMBENT = "Don Davis";
  const FALLBACK_CANDIDATES = [
    { name: "Don Davis", party: "DEM" },
    { name: "Laurie Buckhout", party: "REP" },
    { name: "Tom Bailey", party: "LIB" }
  ];

  const override = new URLSearchParams(location.search).get("data");
  const url = override || DATA_URL;
  const $ = function (id) { return document.getElementById(id); };

  $("repo-link").href = REPO_URL;
  if (override) {
    $("test-notice").hidden = false;
    $("test-notice").textContent = "Test mode. Data comes from " + override + ", not the live file.";
  }

  /* ---------- formatting ---------- */
  const isNum = function (x) { return typeof x === "number" && isFinite(x); };
  const NA = "n/a";
  const int = function (x) { return isNum(x) ? Math.round(x).toLocaleString("en-US") : NA; };
  const pct1 = function (x) { return isNum(x) ? x.toFixed(1) + "%" : NA; };
  const share = function (x) { return isNum(x) ? (x * 100).toFixed(1) + "%" : NA; };
  const margin = function (x, dName, rName) {
    if (!isNum(x)) return NA;
    const v = Math.abs(x).toFixed(1);
    if (v === "0.0") return "Even";
    return (x > 0 ? (dName || "D") : (rName || "R")) + " +" + v;
  };
  const named = function (x) { return margin(x, "Davis", "Buckhout"); };
  const prob = function (p) {
    if (!isNum(p)) return NA;
    if (p >= 0.995) return ">99%";
    if (p <= 0.005) return "<1%";
    return Math.round(p * 100) + "%";
  };
  const titleCase = function (s) {
    return String(s).toLowerCase().replace(/(^|[\s-])([a-z])/g, function (m, a, b) { return a + b.toUpperCase(); });
  };

  const TZ = "America/New_York";
  const timeFmt = new Intl.DateTimeFormat("en-US", { timeZone: TZ, hour: "numeric", minute: "2-digit" });
  const dayFmt = new Intl.DateTimeFormat("en-US", { timeZone: TZ, month: "short", day: "numeric" });
  const validDate = function (iso) { return iso && !isNaN(Date.parse(iso)); };
  const clock = function (ms) { return timeFmt.format(new Date(ms)).replace(/ |\s/g, " ").replace("AM", "am").replace("PM", "pm"); };
  const timeET = function (iso) { return validDate(iso) ? clock(Date.parse(iso)) + " ET" : NA; };
  const whenET = function (iso) {
    if (!validDate(iso)) return NA;
    const d = new Date(iso);
    return dayFmt.format(d) === dayFmt.format(new Date()) ? timeET(iso) : dayFmt.format(d) + ", " + timeET(iso);
  };

  /* ---------- DOM helpers (data only ever goes in through textContent) ---------- */
  function clear(node) { while (node.firstChild) node.removeChild(node.firstChild); }
  // Colour a margin string by its leader: "D +3.1" or "Davis +3.1" blue, "R +3.1" or "Buckhout +3.1" red.
  function tintMargin(el, text) {
    el.classList.remove("m-d", "m-r");
    if (/^(D|Davis) \+/.test(text)) el.classList.add("m-d");
    else if (/^(R|Buckhout) \+/.test(text)) el.classList.add("m-r");
    return el;
  }
  function td(text, tag) {
    const c = document.createElement(tag || "td");
    c.textContent = text;
    return tintMargin(c, String(text));
  }
  function row(cells) {
    const tr = document.createElement("tr");
    cells.forEach(function (c, i) {
      const cell = td(c, i === 0 ? "th" : "td");
      if (i === 0) cell.scope = "row";
      tr.appendChild(cell);
    });
    return tr;
  }
  function emptyRow(body, cols, text) {
    const tr = document.createElement("tr");
    const c = td(text);
    c.colSpan = cols;
    c.style.textAlign = "left";
    c.style.color = "var(--muted)";
    tr.appendChild(c);
    body.appendChild(tr);
  }
  const arr = function (x) { return Array.isArray(x) ? x : []; };
  const svgEl = function (name, attrs) {
    const e = document.createElementNS("http://www.w3.org/2000/svg", name);
    Object.keys(attrs || {}).forEach(function (k) { e.setAttribute(k, attrs[k]); });
    return e;
  };

  /* ---------- sections ---------- */
  function stateLine(s) {
    const call = s.call || {};
    const parts = [];
    if (call.status === "Davis" || call.status === "Buckhout") parts.push("Called for " + call.status + " by this model");
    else if (call.status === "withdrawn") parts.push("Call withdrawn");
    else if (s.status === "pre") parts.push(Date.now() >= POLLS_CLOSE ? "Polls closed at 7:30 pm ET. Waiting for first results" : "Polls close 7:30 pm ET");
    else if (s.status === "final") parts.push("Final unofficial count");
    else if (s.status === "counting") parts.push("Counting");
    if (s.status === "stale") {
      const feed = s.feed || {};
      parts.push("Feed has not updated since " + timeET(feed.last_change_at || feed.last_modified || s.updated_at));
    }
    return parts.join(". ") || "Status not available";
  }

  function renderHead(s) {
    $("state").textContent = stateLine(s);
    const feed = s.feed || {};
    const bits = ["Data updated at " + whenET(s.updated_at) + "."];
    if (validDate(feed.last_change_at)) bits.push("State feed last changed at " + whenET(feed.last_change_at) + ".");
    $("updated").textContent = bits.join(" ");
  }

  let needleShown = false;
  function renderDial(s) {
    const e = s.estimate || {};
    const p = e.p_davis;
    const arm = $("needle-arm"), hub = $("needle-hub"), dial = $("dial");
    dial.classList.toggle("is-stale", s.status === "stale");
    if (isNum(p)) {
      const clamped = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, p));
      const t = "rotate(" + ((clamped - 0.5) * 180).toFixed(2) + "deg)";
      if (!needleShown) {
        arm.style.transform = t;            // first placement does not animate
        arm.getBoundingClientRect();
        arm.classList.add("ease");
        arm.setAttribute("visibility", "visible");
        hub.setAttribute("visibility", "visible");
        needleShown = true;
      } else if (arm.style.transform !== t) {
        arm.style.transform = t;            // eases only when the value changed
      }
    } else {
      arm.setAttribute("visibility", "hidden");
      hub.setAttribute("visibility", "hidden");
      needleShown = false;
      arm.classList.remove("ease");
    }
    $("p-davis").textContent = prob(p);
    $("p-buckhout").textContent = "";
    $("prior-note").hidden = !(s.status === "pre" && isNum(p));
    $("dial-title").textContent = isNum(p)
      ? "Dial showing a " + prob(p) + " chance Davis wins" +
        (isNum(e.p_buckhout) ? " and a " + prob(e.p_buckhout) + " chance Buckhout wins." : ".") +
        (s.status === "stale" ? " The feed has stopped updating." : "")
      : "Dial showing the chance Davis wins. No estimate yet.";
  }

  function renderStats(s) {
    const e = s.estimate || {}, x = s.expected_total || {};
    $("margin").textContent = named(e.margin_mid);
    tintMargin($("margin"), $("margin").textContent);
    $("margin-range").textContent = isNum(e.margin_lo90) && isNum(e.margin_hi90)
      ? "90% interval: " + named(e.margin_lo90) + " to " + named(e.margin_hi90) : "";
    $("counted").textContent = int(s.counted_votes);
    $("expected").textContent = isNum(x.mid)
      ? "Estimated total: " + int(x.mid) + (isNum(x.lo90) && isNum(x.hi90) ? "\n(range " + int(x.lo90) + " to " + int(x.hi90) + ")" : "")
      : "";
    $("share-counted").textContent = isNum(s.pct_counted_est) ? Math.round(s.pct_counted_est) + "%" : NA;
    if (isNum(s.counted_votes) && s.counted_votes > 0 && x.lo90 > 0 && x.hi90 > 0) {
      const lo = Math.min(100, 100 * s.counted_votes / x.hi90), hi = Math.min(100, 100 * s.counted_votes / x.lo90);
      $("share-range").textContent = "Range: " + Math.round(lo) + "% to " + Math.round(hi) + "%";
    } else {
      $("share-range").textContent = "";
    }
  }

  function renderCount(s) {
    const body = $("count-body");
    clear(body);
    const list = arr(s.candidates).length ? s.candidates : FALLBACK_CANDIDATES;
    const colorOf = function (c) { return COLORS[String(c.party || "").charAt(0).toUpperCase()] || COLORS.L; };
    list.forEach(function (c) {
      const party = String(c.party || "");
      const tr = document.createElement("tr");
      const name = td((c.name || NA) + (c.name === INCUMBENT ? "*" : ""), "th");
      name.scope = "row";
      name.style.setProperty("--edge", colorOf(c));
      tr.appendChild(name);
      tr.appendChild(td(PARTY_NAMES[party] || party || NA));
      tr.appendChild(td(int(c.votes)));
      const cell = document.createElement("td");
      cell.className = "pct";
      const wrap = document.createElement("div");
      wrap.className = "pct-wrap";
      const num = document.createElement("span");
      num.textContent = pct1(c.pct);
      const track = document.createElement("span");
      track.className = "bar-track";
      track.setAttribute("aria-hidden", "true");
      const fill = document.createElement("span");
      fill.className = "bar-fill";
      fill.style.width = (isNum(c.pct) ? Math.max(0, Math.min(100, c.pct)) : 0) + "%";
      fill.style.background = colorOf(c);
      track.appendChild(fill);
      wrap.appendChild(num);
      wrap.appendChild(track);
      cell.appendChild(wrap);
      tr.appendChild(cell);
      body.appendChild(tr);
    });
    const total = isNum(s.counted_votes) ? s.counted_votes : null;
    const totRow = document.createElement("tr");
    totRow.className = "total";
    const tn = td("Total reported", "th");
    tn.scope = "row";
    tn.colSpan = 2;
    totRow.appendChild(tn);
    totRow.appendChild(td(int(total)));
    totRow.appendChild(td(""));
    body.appendChild(totRow);

    // Stacked bar over total reported
    const stack = $("stack"), keys = $("stack-keys");
    clear(stack);
    clear(keys);
    const voteSum = list.reduce(function (a, c) { return a + (isNum(c.votes) ? c.votes : 0); }, 0);
    const labels = [];
    list.forEach(function (c) {
      const last = String(c.name || "").split(" ").pop();
      if (voteSum > 0 && isNum(c.votes) && c.votes > 0) {
        const seg = document.createElement("span");
        seg.style.width = (100 * c.votes / voteSum) + "%";
        seg.style.background = colorOf(c);
        stack.appendChild(seg);
        labels.push(last + " " + pct1(100 * c.votes / voteSum));
      }
      const k = document.createElement("span");
      const sw = document.createElement("i");
      sw.style.background = colorOf(c);
      k.appendChild(sw);
      k.appendChild(document.createTextNode(last));
      keys.appendChild(k);
    });
    stack.setAttribute("aria-label", labels.length ? labels.join(", ") + "." : "No votes reported yet.");
    $("stack-total").textContent = total === null ? "" : int(total) + " votes reported";
  }

  /* ---------- county map ---------- */
  // Fixed scales, so a mark means the same thing all night and at every screen width.
  // Lead: the largest county lead in the 2024 presidential vote on these lines was 19,695 (Carteret).
  const LEAD_REF = 20000, LEAD_CLAMP = 30000, LEAD_RMAX = 42;   // map units
  const SWING_UNITS = 2.6, SWING_CLAMP = 30;                    // map units per point; points
  const ARROW_COS = Math.cos(Math.PI / 6), ARROW_SIN = Math.sin(Math.PI / 6);
  const SHARE_BLUE = ["#AECFEE", "#75AEE0", "#3F8CCB", "#1171B9"];
  const SHARE_RED = ["#FDD6C8", "#F6A8A3", "#F0706C", "#EB2326"];
  const SHARE_LABELS = ["Under 50", "50 to 60", "60 to 70", "70 plus"];
  const leadRadius = function (lead) { return LEAD_RMAX * Math.sqrt(Math.min(Math.abs(lead), LEAD_CLAMP) / LEAD_REF); };
  const swingLength = function (s) { return SWING_UNITS * Math.min(Math.abs(s), SWING_CLAMP); };
  // Vs benchmark: triangle height in map units on a fixed scale of net votes ahead of the benchmark.
  const BENCH_REF = 2000, BENCH_UNITS = 50, BENCH_CLAMP = 6000, BENCH_MIN = 50;  // votes, map units, votes, votes
  const benchHeight = function (v) { return BENCH_UNITS * Math.min(Math.abs(v), BENCH_CLAMP) / BENCH_REF; };
  const netVotes = function (v) { return !isNum(v) ? NA : (Math.round(v) === 0 ? "Even" : (v > 0 ? "D +" : "R +") + int(Math.abs(v))); };

  let mapView = "share";
  let mapRows = {};
  let mapPinned = null;
  const cmap = $("cmap");
  const mapPaths = cmap ? Array.prototype.slice.call(cmap.querySelectorAll(".cty")) : [];
  const unitsPerPx = function () {
    const w = cmap.getBoundingClientRect().width;
    return w > 0 ? cmap.viewBox.baseVal.width / w : 1.5;
  };

  function countyInfo(key) {
    const c = mapRows[key] || {};
    const d = c.votes_d, r = c.votes_r, l = c.votes_l;
    const votes = isNum(c.votes) ? c.votes : (isNum(d) && isNum(r) ? d + r + (isNum(l) ? l : 0) : null);
    const has = isNum(d) && isNum(r) && isNum(votes) && votes > 0;
    const leader = has ? (d > r ? "D" : (r > d ? "R" : null)) : null;
    return { c: c, d: d, r: r, l: l, votes: votes, has: has, leader: leader,
             lead: has ? d - r : null, topShare: has ? 100 * Math.max(d, r) / votes : null };
  }
  const shareOf = function (x, votes) { return isNum(x) && isNum(votes) && votes > 0 ? pct1(100 * x / votes) : NA; };

  // Counties with no contested 2024 NC-1 race on these lines carry house2024_margin: null.
  const NOT_IN_HOUSE = "Not in the 2024 NC-1 race";
  const notInHouse = function (c) { return Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(c, "house2024_margin") && c.house2024_margin === null; };

  function detailRows(i) {
    const c = i.c;
    const prec = isNum(c.precincts_reported) && isNum(c.precincts_total) ? c.precincts_reported + " of " + c.precincts_total : NA;
    if (mapView === "swing") {
      const out = notInHouse(c);
      return [
        ["Davis", isNum(i.d) ? int(i.d) + " (" + shareOf(i.d, i.votes) + ")" : NA],
        ["Buckhout", isNum(i.r) ? int(i.r) + " (" + shareOf(i.r, i.votes) + ")" : NA],
        ["Bailey", isNum(i.l) ? int(i.l) + " (" + shareOf(i.l, i.votes) + ")" : NA],
        ["Margin", margin(c.margin)],
        ["2024 NC-1 margin", out ? NOT_IN_HOUSE : margin(c.house2024_margin)],
        ["Shift", out ? NA : margin(c.swing_house)],
        ["Precincts reported", prec]
      ];
    }
    if (mapView === "bench") {
      const none = !i.has || !isNum(c.benchmark_margin);
      return [
        ["Margin", i.has ? margin(c.margin) : "No votes yet"],
        ["Benchmark", none ? NA : margin(c.benchmark_margin)],
        ["Vs benchmark", none || !isNum(c.vs_benchmark) ? NA : margin(c.vs_benchmark) + " pts"],
        ["Net votes vs benchmark", none ? NA : netVotes(c.vs_benchmark_votes)],
        ["Precincts reported", prec]
      ];
    }
    return [
      ["Davis", isNum(i.d) ? int(i.d) + " (" + shareOf(i.d, i.votes) + ")" : NA],
      ["Buckhout", isNum(i.r) ? int(i.r) + " (" + shareOf(i.r, i.votes) + ")" : NA],
      ["Bailey", isNum(i.l) ? int(i.l) + " (" + shareOf(i.l, i.votes) + ")" : NA],
      ["Margin", margin(c.margin)],
      ["Shift from 2024 NC-1", notInHouse(c) ? NOT_IN_HOUSE : margin(c.swing_house)],
      ["Precincts reported", prec]
    ];
  }

  function drawMapMarks() {
    const overlay = $("cmap-overlay");
    clear(overlay);
    const u = unitsPerPx();
    cmap.style.setProperty("--u", u);
    const dotp = $("cmap-nohouse");
    if (dotp) {
      const ds = 4.5 * u;
      dotp.setAttribute("width", ds); dotp.setAttribute("height", ds);
      dotp.firstChild.setAttribute("width", ds); dotp.firstChild.setAttribute("height", ds);
      dotp.lastChild.setAttribute("cx", ds / 2); dotp.lastChild.setAttribute("cy", ds / 2); dotp.lastChild.setAttribute("r", 1 * u);
    }
    const hatch = $("cmap-novotes");
    if (hatch) {
      const size = 5 * u;
      hatch.setAttribute("width", size);
      hatch.setAttribute("height", size);
      hatch.firstChild.setAttribute("width", size);
      hatch.firstChild.setAttribute("height", size);
      hatch.lastChild.setAttribute("x2", size);
      hatch.lastChild.setAttribute("stroke-width", 1.5 * u);
      hatch.lastChild.setAttribute("y1", size / 2);
      hatch.lastChild.setAttribute("y2", size / 2);
    }
    cmap.classList.toggle("plain", mapView !== "share");
    mapPaths.forEach(function (p) {
      const i = countyInfo(p.dataset.c);
      if (mapView === "share") {
        if (i.leader) {
          const bin = i.topShare < 50 ? 0 : i.topShare < 60 ? 1 : i.topShare < 70 ? 2 : 3;
          p.style.fill = (i.leader === "D" ? SHARE_BLUE : SHARE_RED)[bin];
        } else {
          p.style.fill = "url(#cmap-novotes)";
        }
      } else if (mapView === "swing" && notInHouse(i.c)) {
        p.style.fill = "url(#cmap-nohouse)";
      } else {
        p.style.fill = "";
      }
      const detail = detailRows(i).map(function (r) { return r[0] + " " + r[1]; }).join(", ");
      p.setAttribute("aria-label", p.dataset.n + " County. " + detail + ".");
    });
    if (mapView === "lead") {
      mapPaths.map(function (p) { return { x: +p.dataset.x, y: +p.dataset.y, i: countyInfo(p.dataset.c) }; })
        .filter(function (m) { return m.i.leader; })
        .sort(function (a, b) { return Math.abs(b.i.lead) - Math.abs(a.i.lead); })
        .forEach(function (m) {
          const color = m.i.leader === "D" ? COLORS.D : COLORS.R;
          overlay.appendChild(svgEl("circle", { cx: m.x, cy: m.y, r: Math.max(leadRadius(m.i.lead), 1.5 * u),
            fill: color, "fill-opacity": 0.3, stroke: color, "stroke-width": 1.25 * u }));
        });
    } else if (mapView === "swing") {
      mapPaths.forEach(function (p) {
        const ci = countyInfo(p.dataset.c);
        const s = ci.c.swing_house;
        if (!isNum(s) || !ci.has || notInHouse(ci.c)) return;
        overlay.appendChild(arrow(+p.dataset.x, +p.dataset.y, s, swingLength(s), u));
      });
    } else if (mapView === "bench") {
      mapPaths.map(function (p) { return { x: +p.dataset.x, y: +p.dataset.y, i: countyInfo(p.dataset.c) }; })
        .sort(function (a, b) { return Math.abs(b.i.c.vs_benchmark_votes || 0) - Math.abs(a.i.c.vs_benchmark_votes || 0); })
        .forEach(function (m) { overlay.appendChild(benchMark(m.x, m.y, m.i.has ? m.i.c.vs_benchmark_votes : null, u, 1)); });
    }
    drawLegend(u);
    drawMapDesc();
    if (mapPinned) showMapTip(mapPinned);
  }

  // Up and left for a Democratic shift, up and right for a Republican one. Length in the units of the svg it sits in.
  function arrow(x, y, s, len, u) {
    const dir = s > 0 ? -1 : 1;
    const color = s > 0 ? COLORS.D : COLORS.R;
    const L = Math.max(len, 5 * u);
    const head = Math.min(7.5 * u, 0.6 * L), half = head * 0.42;
    const ux = dir * ARROW_COS, uy = -ARROW_SIN;
    const ex = x + ux * L, ey = y + uy * L;
    const bx = ex - ux * head, by = ey - uy * head;
    const g = svgEl("g", {});
    if (L > head) {
      g.appendChild(svgEl("line", { x1: x, y1: y, x2: bx, y2: by, stroke: "#fff", "stroke-opacity": 0.85, "stroke-width": 3.5 * u, "stroke-linecap": "round" }));
    }
    const pts = [[ex, ey], [bx - uy * half, by + ux * half], [bx + uy * half, by - ux * half]]
      .map(function (q) { return q[0].toFixed(1) + "," + q[1].toFixed(1); }).join(" ");
    g.appendChild(svgEl("polygon", { points: pts, fill: color, stroke: "#fff", "stroke-opacity": 0.85, "stroke-width": 0.75 * u, "paint-order": "stroke" }));
    if (L > head) {
      g.appendChild(svgEl("line", { x1: x, y1: y, x2: bx, y2: by, stroke: color, "stroke-width": 1.75 * u, "stroke-linecap": "butt" }));
    }
    return g;
  }

  // Upward triangle with its base centred on (x, y), coloured by who is ahead of the benchmark;
  // a short flat line when the county is within BENCH_MIN votes of it or has no votes. k converts map units.
  function benchMark(x, y, v, u, k, color) {
    const half = Math.max(10 * k, 5 * u);
    if (!isNum(v) || Math.abs(v) < BENCH_MIN) {
      return svgEl("line", { x1: x - half, x2: x + half, y1: y, y2: y, stroke: "#7a838e", "stroke-width": 2 * u, "stroke-linecap": "round" });
    }
    const h = Math.max(benchHeight(v) * k, 4 * u);
    const pts = [[x - half, y], [x + half, y], [x, y - h]].map(function (q) { return q[0].toFixed(1) + "," + q[1].toFixed(1); }).join(" ");
    return svgEl("polygon", { points: pts, fill: color || (v > 0 ? COLORS.D : COLORS.R), "fill-opacity": 0.9, stroke: "#fff", "stroke-width": 0.75 * u, "stroke-linejoin": "round", "paint-order": "stroke" });
  }

  function legendText(tag, cls, text) {
    const e = document.createElement(tag);
    if (cls) e.className = cls;
    e.textContent = text;
    return e;
  }

  function drawLegend(u) {
    const box = $("map-legend");
    clear(box);
    if (mapView === "share") {
      box.appendChild(legendText("p", "lg-title", "Leader's share of all votes"));
      const grid = document.createElement("div");
      grid.className = "lg-grid";
      [["Davis", SHARE_BLUE], ["Buckhout", SHARE_RED]].forEach(function (row) {
        grid.appendChild(legendText("span", "nm", row[0]));
        row[1].forEach(function (col) {
          const sw = document.createElement("span");
          sw.className = "sw";
          sw.style.background = col;
          grid.appendChild(sw);
        });
      });
      grid.appendChild(document.createElement("span"));
      SHARE_LABELS.forEach(function (lab) { grid.appendChild(legendText("span", "ax", lab)); });
      box.appendChild(grid);
      const none = document.createElement("div");
      none.className = "lg-none";
      none.appendChild(document.createElement("i"));
      none.appendChild(legendText("span", "", "No votes"));
      box.appendChild(none);
    } else if (mapView === "lead") {
      const row = document.createElement("div");
      row.className = "lg-row";
      [["Davis ahead", COLORS.D], ["Buckhout ahead", COLORS.R]].forEach(function (x) {
        const it = document.createElement("div");
        it.className = "lg-item";
        const sv = svgEl("svg", { width: 16, height: 16, viewBox: "0 0 16 16", "aria-hidden": "true" });
        sv.appendChild(svgEl("circle", { cx: 8, cy: 8, r: 7, fill: x[1], "fill-opacity": 0.3, stroke: x[1], "stroke-width": 1.25 }));
        it.appendChild(sv);
        it.appendChild(legendText("span", "", x[0]));
        row.appendChild(it);
      });
      box.appendChild(row);
      const sizes = document.createElement("div");
      sizes.className = "lg-row";
      [1000, 5000, 20000].forEach(function (v) {
        const r = leadRadius(v) / u;
        const it = document.createElement("div");
        it.className = "lg-item";
        const sv = svgEl("svg", { width: 2 * r + 2, height: 2 * r + 2, viewBox: "0 0 " + (2 * r + 2) + " " + (2 * r + 2), "aria-hidden": "true" });
        sv.appendChild(svgEl("circle", { cx: r + 1, cy: r + 1, r: r, fill: "#7a838e", "fill-opacity": 0.25, stroke: "#56606c", "stroke-width": 1 }));
        it.appendChild(sv);
        it.appendChild(legendText("span", "", int(v) + " votes"));
        sizes.appendChild(it);
      });
      box.appendChild(sizes);
      box.appendChild(legendText("p", "lg-note", "Circle size is proportional to candidates' county-level lead."));
    } else if (mapView === "bench") {
      // draft for ZH: legend wording
      box.appendChild(legendText("p", "lg-title", "Ahead of benchmark"));
      const sample = function (v, label, color) {
        const it = document.createElement("div");
        it.className = "lg-item";
        const h = isNum(v) && Math.abs(v) >= BENCH_MIN ? Math.max(benchHeight(v) / u, 4) : 4;
        const w = 2 * Math.max(10 / u, 5) + 4;
        const sv = svgEl("svg", { width: w, height: h + 4, viewBox: "0 0 " + w + " " + (h + 4), "aria-hidden": "true" });
        sv.appendChild(benchMark(w / 2, h + 2, v, 1, 1 / u, color));
        it.appendChild(sv);
        it.appendChild(legendText("span", "", label));
        return it;
      };
      const row = document.createElement("div");
      row.className = "lg-row";
      row.appendChild(sample(1000, "Davis"));
      row.appendChild(sample(-1000, "Buckhout"));
      box.appendChild(row);
      const sizes = document.createElement("div");
      sizes.className = "lg-row";
      [500, 2000].forEach(function (v) { sizes.appendChild(sample(v, int(v) + " votes", "#8a929c")); });
      sizes.appendChild(sample(null, "Within " + BENCH_MIN + " votes, or no votes yet"));
      box.appendChild(sizes);
    } else {
      box.appendChild(legendText("p", "lg-title", "Shift in margin from the 2024 NC-1 race"));
      const row = document.createElement("div");
      row.className = "lg-row";
      const sample = function (s, label, boxW) {
        const it = document.createElement("div");
        it.className = "lg-item";
        const len = swingLength(s) / u;
        const w = Math.max(len * ARROW_COS, 8) + 6, h = Math.max(len * ARROW_SIN, 5) + 8;
        const sv = svgEl("svg", { width: boxW || w, height: h, viewBox: "0 0 " + (boxW || w) + " " + h, "aria-hidden": "true" });
        const x0 = s > 0 ? (boxW || w) - 3 : 3;
        sv.appendChild(arrow(x0, h - 3, s, len, 1));
        if (s > 0) { it.appendChild(sv); it.appendChild(legendText("span", "", label)); }
        else { it.appendChild(legendText("span", "", label)); it.appendChild(sv); }
        return it;
      };
      row.appendChild(sample(10, "More Dem."));
      row.appendChild(sample(-10, "More Rep."));
      box.appendChild(row);
      const scale = document.createElement("div");
      scale.className = "lg-row";
      [5, 10, 20].forEach(function (pts) { scale.appendChild(sample(pts, pts + " points")); });
      box.appendChild(scale);
      const nh = document.createElement("div");
      nh.className = "lg-none";
      const nhi = document.createElement("i");
      nhi.className = "nohouse";
      nh.appendChild(nhi);
      nh.appendChild(legendText("span", "", NOT_IN_HOUSE));
      box.appendChild(nh);
    }
    const split = legendText("p", "lg-note", "Granville and Onslow show only the part in the district.");
    box.appendChild(split);
  }

  function drawMapDesc() {
    const rows = mapPaths.map(function (p) { return countyInfo(p.dataset.c); });
    const nd = rows.filter(function (i) { return i.leader === "D"; }).length;
    const nr = rows.filter(function (i) { return i.leader === "R"; }).length;
    $("cmap-desc").textContent = "Map of the " + mapPaths.length + " counties in the district. Davis leads in " + nd +
      ", Buckhout leads in " + nr + ", and " + (mapPaths.length - nd - nr) + " have no leader yet. Each county can be focused for its details, and the county table below has the same results.";
  }

  function showMapTip(p) {
    const tip = $("map-tip"), wrap = $("cmap-wrap");
    const i = countyInfo(p.dataset.c);
    clear(tip);
    tip.appendChild(legendText("div", "tt-name", p.dataset.n));
    detailRows(i).forEach(function (r) {
      const row = document.createElement("div");
      row.className = "tt-row";
      row.appendChild(legendText("span", "", r[0]));
      const v = tintMargin(legendText("span", "", r[1]), String(r[1]));
      row.appendChild(v);
      tip.appendChild(row);
    });
    tip.hidden = false;
    const old = cmap.querySelector(".hl");
    if (old) old.parentNode.removeChild(old);
    cmap.querySelector("#cmap-overlay").appendChild(svgEl("path", { class: "hl", d: p.getAttribute("d") }));
    const u = unitsPerPx();
    const x = +p.dataset.x / u, y = +p.dataset.y / u;
    const tw = tip.offsetWidth, th = tip.offsetHeight, ww = wrap.clientWidth;
    tip.style.left = Math.max(0, Math.min(ww - tw, x - tw / 2)) + "px";
    tip.style.top = (y - th - 12 >= 0 ? y - th - 12 : y + 12) + "px";
  }

  function hideMapTip() {
    $("map-tip").hidden = true;
    const old = cmap.querySelector(".hl");
    if (old) old.parentNode.removeChild(old);
  }

  function renderMap(s) {
    if (!cmap) return;
    mapRows = {};
    arr(s.by_county).forEach(function (c) { if (c && c.county) mapRows[String(c.county).toUpperCase()] = c; });
    drawMapMarks();
  }

  (function wireMap() {
    if (!cmap) return;
    const defs = svgEl("defs", {});
    const pat = svgEl("pattern", { id: "cmap-novotes", patternUnits: "userSpaceOnUse", width: 8, height: 8, patternTransform: "rotate(45)" });
    pat.appendChild(svgEl("rect", { width: 8, height: 8, fill: "#e9e8e4" }));
    pat.appendChild(svgEl("line", { x1: 0, y1: 4, x2: 8, y2: 4, stroke: "#c9c8c3", "stroke-width": 2 }));
    defs.appendChild(pat);
    const dots = svgEl("pattern", { id: "cmap-nohouse", patternUnits: "userSpaceOnUse", width: 6, height: 6 });
    dots.appendChild(svgEl("rect", { width: 6, height: 6, fill: "#f3f2ee" }));
    dots.appendChild(svgEl("circle", { cx: 3, cy: 3, r: 1.1, fill: "#b9b7b0" }));
    defs.appendChild(dots);
    cmap.insertBefore(defs, cmap.firstChild);
    document.querySelectorAll("#view-toggle button").forEach(function (b) {
      b.addEventListener("click", function () {
        mapView = b.dataset.view;
        document.querySelectorAll("#view-toggle button").forEach(function (x) {
          x.setAttribute("aria-pressed", x === b ? "true" : "false");
        });
        drawMapMarks();
      });
    });
    mapPaths.forEach(function (p) {
      const targets = [p];
      const box = p.getBBox();
      if (box.width < 30 && box.height < 30) {
        const hit = svgEl("circle", { cx: p.dataset.x, cy: p.dataset.y, r: 18, fill: "transparent", "aria-hidden": "true" });
        hit.style.cursor = "pointer";
        $("cmap-counties").appendChild(hit);
        targets.push(hit);
      }
      targets.forEach(function (el) {
        el.addEventListener("pointerenter", function (ev) {
          if (ev.pointerType === "mouse" && !mapPinned) showMapTip(p);
        });
        el.addEventListener("pointerleave", function (ev) {
          if (ev.pointerType === "mouse" && !mapPinned) hideMapTip();
        });
        el.addEventListener("click", function (ev) {
          ev.stopPropagation();
          if (mapPinned === p) { mapPinned = null; hideMapTip(); }
          else { mapPinned = p; showMapTip(p); }
        });
      });
      p.addEventListener("focus", function () {
        if (p.matches(":focus-visible")) showMapTip(p);
      });
      p.addEventListener("blur", function () {
        if (mapPinned !== p) hideMapTip();
      });
      p.addEventListener("keydown", function (ev) {
        if (ev.key === "Escape") { mapPinned = null; hideMapTip(); }
        else if (ev.key === "Enter" || ev.key === " ") {
          ev.preventDefault();
          if (mapPinned === p) { mapPinned = null; hideMapTip(); }
          else { mapPinned = p; showMapTip(p); }
        }
      });
    });
    document.addEventListener("click", function () {
      if (mapPinned) { mapPinned = null; hideMapTip(); }
    });
    let lastW = 0;
    if (window.ResizeObserver) {
      new ResizeObserver(function (entries) {
        const w = entries[0].contentRect.width;
        if (Math.abs(w - lastW) > 1) { lastW = w; drawMapMarks(); }
      }).observe($("cmap-wrap"));
    }
  })();

  /* ---------- history chart ---------- */
  let histData = [];
  let histIndex = null;
  let histGeom = null;

  function renderHistoryData(s) {
    histData = arr(s.history)
      .filter(function (h) { return h && isNum(h.p_davis) && validDate(h.t); })
      .map(function (h) { return Object.assign({}, h, { ms: Date.parse(h.t) }); })
      .sort(function (a, b) { return a.ms - b.ms; });
    $("hist-empty").hidden = histData.length > 0;
    $("hist-chart").hidden = histData.length === 0;
    const body = $("hist-body");
    clear(body);
    if (!histData.length) emptyRow(body, 4, "No history yet.");
    histData.slice().reverse().forEach(function (h) {
      body.appendChild(row([whenET(h.t), prob(h.p_davis), named(h.margin_mid), int(h.counted_votes)]));
    });
    histIndex = null;
    drawHistory();
  }

  function drawHistory() {
    const box = $("hist-chart");
    clear(box);
    histGeom = null;
    if (!histData.length) return;
    const W = Math.max(280, box.clientWidth || 700);
    const H = W < 480 ? 210 : 260;
    const m = { l: 40, r: 44, t: 12, b: 26 };
    const pw = W - m.l - m.r, ph = H - m.t - m.b;
    const t0 = histData[0].ms, t1 = histData[histData.length - 1].ms;
    const span = t1 - t0;
    const xOf = function (t) { return span > 0 ? m.l + (t - t0) / span * pw : m.l + pw / 2; };
    const yOf = function (p) { return m.t + (1 - p) * ph; };
    const svg = svgEl("svg", { viewBox: "0 0 " + W + " " + H, height: H, "aria-hidden": "true" });

    [0, 0.25, 0.5, 0.75, 1].forEach(function (p) {
      svg.appendChild(svgEl("line", { x1: m.l, x2: W - m.r, y1: yOf(p), y2: yOf(p), stroke: p === 0.5 ? "#aab1ba" : "#e3e6ea", "stroke-width": 1 }));
      const lab = svgEl("text", { x: m.l - 6, y: yOf(p) + 4, "text-anchor": "end" });
      lab.textContent = Math.round(p * 100) + "%";
      svg.appendChild(lab);
    });

    const steps = [5, 10, 15, 30, 60, 120, 240, 480, 1440];
    const maxTicks = Math.max(2, Math.floor(pw / 70));
    let step = steps[steps.length - 1] * 60000;
    for (let i = 0; i < steps.length; i++) {
      if (span / (steps[i] * 60000) <= maxTicks) { step = steps[i] * 60000; break; }
    }
    const ticks = [];
    if (span > 0) {
      for (let t = Math.ceil(t0 / step) * step; t <= t1; t += step) ticks.push(t);
    }
    if (ticks.length === 0) ticks.push(t0);
    ticks.forEach(function (t) {
      svg.appendChild(svgEl("line", { x1: xOf(t), x2: xOf(t), y1: m.t + ph, y2: m.t + ph + 4, stroke: "#aab1ba", "stroke-width": 1 }));
      const lab = svgEl("text", { x: xOf(t), y: H - 6, "text-anchor": "middle" });
      lab.textContent = clock(t);
      svg.appendChild(lab);
    });

    if (histData.length > 1) {
      const d = histData.map(function (h, i) { return (i ? "L" : "M") + xOf(h.ms).toFixed(1) + " " + yOf(h.p_davis).toFixed(1); }).join(" ");
      svg.appendChild(svgEl("path", { d: d, fill: "none", stroke: "#1171B9", "stroke-width": 2, "stroke-linejoin": "round", "stroke-linecap": "round" }));
    }
    const last = histData[histData.length - 1];
    svg.appendChild(svgEl("circle", { cx: xOf(last.ms), cy: yOf(last.p_davis), r: 4, fill: "#1171B9", stroke: "#fff", "stroke-width": 2 }));
    const endLab = svgEl("text", { class: "end", x: xOf(last.ms) + 8, y: yOf(last.p_davis) + 4 });
    endLab.textContent = prob(last.p_davis);
    svg.appendChild(endLab);

    const cross = svgEl("line", { y1: m.t, y2: m.t + ph, stroke: "#7a838e", "stroke-width": 1, visibility: "hidden" });
    const dot = svgEl("circle", { r: 4, fill: "#1171B9", stroke: "#fff", "stroke-width": 2, visibility: "hidden" });
    svg.appendChild(cross);
    svg.appendChild(dot);
    box.appendChild(svg);

    const tip = document.createElement("div");
    tip.className = "tip";
    tip.hidden = true;
    box.appendChild(tip);
    histGeom = { xOf: xOf, yOf: yOf, cross: cross, dot: dot, tip: tip, W: W };
    if (histIndex !== null) showPoint(histIndex);
  }

  function showPoint(i) {
    if (!histGeom || !histData[i]) return;
    histIndex = i;
    const g = histGeom, h = histData[i], x = g.xOf(h.ms);
    g.cross.setAttribute("x1", x); g.cross.setAttribute("x2", x); g.cross.setAttribute("visibility", "visible");
    g.dot.setAttribute("cx", x); g.dot.setAttribute("cy", g.yOf(h.p_davis)); g.dot.setAttribute("visibility", "visible");
    clear(g.tip);
    [[prob(h.p_davis), "chance Davis wins"], [named(h.margin_mid), "estimated margin"], [int(h.counted_votes), "votes counted"], [timeET(h.t), ""]]
      .forEach(function (r) {
        const line = document.createElement("div");
        const b = document.createElement("b"); b.textContent = r[0];
        const sp = document.createElement("span"); sp.textContent = r[1] ? " " + r[1] : "";
        line.appendChild(b); line.appendChild(sp);
        g.tip.appendChild(line);
      });
    g.tip.hidden = false;
    const tw = g.tip.offsetWidth;
    g.tip.style.left = (x + 12 + tw > g.W ? Math.max(0, x - 12 - tw) : x + 12) + "px";
  }

  function hidePoint() {
    histIndex = null;
    if (!histGeom) return;
    histGeom.cross.setAttribute("visibility", "hidden");
    histGeom.dot.setAttribute("visibility", "hidden");
    histGeom.tip.hidden = true;
  }

  (function wireChart() {
    const box = $("hist-chart");
    function nearest(ev) {
      if (!histGeom || !histData.length) return;
      const rect = box.getBoundingClientRect();
      const px = ev.clientX - rect.left;
      let best = 0, bestD = Infinity;
      histData.forEach(function (h, i) {
        const d = Math.abs(histGeom.xOf(h.ms) - px);
        if (d < bestD) { bestD = d; best = i; }
      });
      showPoint(best);
    }
    box.addEventListener("pointermove", nearest);
    box.addEventListener("pointerdown", nearest);
    box.addEventListener("pointerleave", hidePoint);
    box.addEventListener("focus", function () {
      if (box.matches(":focus-visible") && histData.length) showPoint(histData.length - 1);
    });
    box.addEventListener("blur", hidePoint);
    box.addEventListener("keydown", function (ev) {
      if (!histData.length) return;
      if (ev.key === "ArrowLeft" || ev.key === "ArrowRight") {
        ev.preventDefault();
        const cur = histIndex === null ? histData.length - 1 : histIndex;
        showPoint(Math.max(0, Math.min(histData.length - 1, cur + (ev.key === "ArrowLeft" ? -1 : 1))));
      }
    });
    let lastW = 0;
    if (window.ResizeObserver) {
      new ResizeObserver(function (entries) {
        const w = entries[0].contentRect.width;
        if (Math.abs(w - lastW) > 1) { lastW = w; drawHistory(); }
      }).observe(box);
    }
  })();

  /* ---------- estimate by county ---------- */
  const RP = { blue95: "#AECFEE", red95: "#FDD6C8", blue50: "#75AEE0", red50: "#F6A8A3" };
  const pctIn = function (p) {
    if (!isNum(p)) return NA;
    if (p <= 0) return "0%";
    if (p < 1) return "<1%";
    if (p > 99 && p < 100) return ">99%";
    return Math.round(Math.min(p, 100)) + "%";
  };
  const axisLabel = function (v) { return v === 0 ? "Even" : (v > 0 ? "D+" : "R+") + Math.abs(v); };
  const rangeText = function (lo, hi) { return isNum(lo) && isNum(hi) ? margin(lo) + " to " + margin(hi) : NA; };

  function rangeDomain(rows) {
    let mx = 0;
    rows.forEach(function (r) {
      [r.lo95, r.hi95, r.lo50, r.hi50, r.mid].forEach(function (v) { if (isNum(v)) mx = Math.max(mx, Math.abs(v)); });
    });
    return Math.min(100, Math.max(20, Math.ceil(mx / 20) * 20));
  }

  function rangeAxis(D) {
    const ax = document.createElement("div");
    ax.className = "rp-axis";
    [-D, -D / 2, 0, D / 2, D].forEach(function (v, i, all) {
      const sp = document.createElement("span");
      sp.textContent = axisLabel(v);
      sp.style.left = (50 + 50 * v / D) + "%";
      if (i === 0) sp.className = "first";
      else if (i === all.length - 1) sp.className = "last";
      else if (v === 0) sp.className = "even";
      ax.appendChild(sp);
    });
    return ax;
  }

  function rangePlot(r, D) {
    const box = document.createElement("div");
    box.className = "rp";
    box.setAttribute("aria-hidden", "true");
    const pos = function (v) { return 50 + 50 * Math.max(-D, Math.min(D, v)) / D; };
    const bar = function (cls, lo, hi, blue, red) {
      if (!isNum(lo) || !isNum(hi)) return;
      const a = Math.min(lo, hi), b = Math.max(lo, hi);
      const seg = function (x0, x1, col) {
        const i = document.createElement("i");
        i.className = cls;
        i.style.left = pos(x0) + "%";
        i.style.width = Math.max(pos(x1) - pos(x0), 0.6) + "%";
        i.style.background = col;
        box.appendChild(i);
      };
      if (a < 0 && b > 0) { seg(a, 0, red); seg(0, b, blue); }
      else seg(a, b, b > 0 ? blue : red);
    };
    [-D / 2, D / 2].forEach(function (v) {
      const g = document.createElement("i"); g.className = "grid"; g.style.left = pos(v) + "%"; box.appendChild(g);
    });
    const z = document.createElement("i"); z.className = "zero"; z.style.left = "50%"; box.appendChild(z);
    bar("b95", r.lo95, r.hi95, RP.blue95, RP.red95);
    bar("b50", r.lo50, r.hi50, RP.blue50, RP.red50);
    if (isNum(r.mid)) {
      const d = document.createElement("i");
      d.className = "dot";
      d.style.left = pos(r.mid) + "%";
      d.style.background = r.mid > 0 ? COLORS.D : (r.mid < 0 ? COLORS.R : "#56606c");
      box.appendChild(d);
    }
    return box;
  }

  function renderEstimates(s) {
    const head = $("est-head"), body = $("est-body");
    clear(head); clear(body);
    const e = s.estimate || {};
    const cands = arr(s.candidates);
    const vd = cands.filter(function (c) { return c.party === "DEM"; }).reduce(function (a, c) { return a + (isNum(c.votes) ? c.votes : 0); }, 0);
    const vr = cands.filter(function (c) { return c.party === "REP"; }).reduce(function (a, c) { return a + (isNum(c.votes) ? c.votes : 0); }, 0);
    const totalVotes = isNum(s.counted_votes) ? s.counted_votes : 0;
    const total = { name: "NC-1 total", total: true, pct: s.pct_counted_est, votes: totalVotes,
                    now: totalVotes > 0 && (vd || vr) ? 100 * (vd - vr) / totalVotes : null,
                    mid: e.margin_mid, lo50: e.margin_lo50, hi50: e.margin_hi50, lo95: e.margin_lo95, hi95: e.margin_hi95 };
    const counties = arr(s.by_county).filter(function (c) { return c && c.county; }).map(function (c) {
      const v = isNum(c.votes) ? c.votes : 0;
      return { name: titleCase(c.county), pct: c.pct_counted_est, votes: v, now: v > 0 ? c.margin : null,
               mid: c.est_margin_mid, lo50: c.est_margin_lo50, hi50: c.est_margin_hi50, lo95: c.est_margin_lo95, hi95: c.est_margin_hi95 };
    }).sort(function (a, b) {
      const an = !isNum(a.mid), bn = !isNum(b.mid);
      if (an || bn) return an === bn ? a.name.localeCompare(b.name) : (an ? 1 : -1);
      return b.mid - a.mid || a.name.localeCompare(b.name);
    });
    const rows = [total].concat(counties);
    const D = rangeDomain(rows);

    const htr = document.createElement("tr");
    ["County", "Votes in", "Leader now", "Est. final"].forEach(function (t) {
      const th = td(t, "th"); th.scope = "col"; htr.appendChild(th);
    });
    const axTh = document.createElement("th");
    axTh.className = "rp-cell";
    axTh.scope = "col";
    axTh.appendChild(legendText("span", "sr-text", "Range of outcomes"));
    axTh.appendChild(rangeAxis(D));
    htr.appendChild(axTh);
    head.appendChild(htr);
    const nar = document.createElement("tr");
    nar.className = "rp-narrow";
    nar.setAttribute("aria-hidden", "true");
    const nth = document.createElement("th");
    nth.colSpan = 4;
    nth.appendChild(rangeAxis(D));
    nar.appendChild(nth);
    head.appendChild(nar);

    if (!counties.length && !isNum(total.mid)) { emptyRow(body, 5, "Not available yet."); return; }
    rows.forEach(function (r) {
      const tr = document.createElement("tr");
      tr.className = "main" + (r.total ? " total" : "") + (!r.votes ? " novotes" : "");
      const th = td(r.name, "th"); th.scope = "row"; tr.appendChild(th);
      if (!r.votes) {
        const nv = td("No votes yet");
        nv.colSpan = 2;
        nv.className = "nv";
        tr.appendChild(nv);
      } else {
        tr.appendChild(td(pctIn(r.pct)));
        tr.appendChild(td(margin(r.now)));
      }
      tr.appendChild(td(margin(r.mid)));
      const sr = "Best guess " + margin(r.mid) + ". 50% of outcomes " + rangeText(r.lo50, r.hi50) + ". 95% of outcomes " + rangeText(r.lo95, r.hi95) + ".";
      const cell = document.createElement("td");
      cell.className = "rp-cell";
      cell.appendChild(rangePlot(r, D));
      cell.appendChild(legendText("span", "sr-text", sr));
      tr.appendChild(cell);
      body.appendChild(tr);
      const tr2 = document.createElement("tr");
      tr2.className = "rp-narrow" + (r.total ? " total" : "");
      tr2.setAttribute("aria-hidden", "true");
      const c2 = document.createElement("td");
      c2.colSpan = 4;
      c2.appendChild(rangePlot(r, D));
      tr2.appendChild(c2);
      body.appendChild(tr2);
    });
  }

  /* ---------- estimate of the final margin over time ---------- */
  let trendData = [];
  let trendIndex = null;
  let trendGeom = null;
  let trendFinal = false;

  function renderTrend(s) {
    trendFinal = s.status === "final";
    trendData = arr(s.history)
      .filter(function (h) { return h && validDate(h.t); })
      .map(function (h) { return Object.assign({}, h, { ms: Date.parse(h.t) }); })
      .filter(function (h) { return isNum(h.margin_mid) || isNum(h.reported_margin) || isNum(h.pct_counted_est); })
      .sort(function (a, b) { return a.ms - b.ms; });
    $("trend-empty").hidden = trendData.length > 0;
    $("trend-chart").hidden = trendData.length === 0;
    const body = $("trend-body");
    clear(body);
    if (!trendData.length) emptyRow(body, 6, "No history yet.");
    trendData.slice().reverse().forEach(function (h) {
      body.appendChild(row([whenET(h.t), margin(h.margin_mid), rangeText(h.margin_lo50, h.margin_hi50), rangeText(h.margin_lo95, h.margin_hi95), margin(h.reported_margin), pctIn(h.pct_counted_est)]));
    });
    const lastMid = lastWith("margin_mid"), lastRep = lastWith("reported_margin"), lastPct = lastWith("pct_counted_est");
    const bits = ["Chart of the estimated final margin over time, with the reported margin and the share of expected turnout reported."];
    if (lastMid) bits.push("Latest estimate " + named(lastMid.margin_mid) + " as of " + timeET(lastMid.t) +
      (isNum(lastMid.margin_lo95) && isNum(lastMid.margin_hi95) ? ", 95% of outcomes " + rangeText(lastMid.margin_lo95, lastMid.margin_hi95) : "") + ".");
    if (lastRep) bits.push("Reported margin " + named(lastRep.reported_margin) + ".");
    if (lastPct) bits.push(pctIn(lastPct.pct_counted_est) + " of expected turnout reported.");
    bits.push("Use the left and right arrow keys to move between updates.");
    $("trend-chart").setAttribute("aria-label", bits.join(" "));
    trendIndex = null;
    drawTrend();
  }

  function lastWith(key) {
    for (let i = trendData.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) if (isNum(trendData[i][key])) return trendData[i];
    return null;
  }

  // Runs of consecutive points where every key is a number, so gaps in old or sparse data are not bridged.
  function runs(keys) {
    const out = [];
    let cur = [];
    trendData.forEach(function (h) {
      if (keys.every(function (k) { return isNum(h[k]); })) cur.push(h);
      else if (cur.length) { out.push(cur); cur = []; }
    });
    if (cur.length) out.push(cur);
    return out;
  }

  function timeTicks(t0, t1, pw) {
    const span = t1 - t0;
    const steps = [5, 10, 15, 30, 60, 120, 240, 480, 1440];
    const maxTicks = Math.max(3, Math.floor(pw / 64));
    let step = steps[steps.length - 1] * 60000;
    for (let i = 0; i < steps.length; i++) {
      if (span / (steps[i] * 60000) <= maxTicks) { step = steps[i] * 60000; break; }
    }
    const ticks = [];
    if (span > 0) for (let t = Math.ceil(t0 / step) * step; t <= t1; t += step) ticks.push(t);
    if (!ticks.length) ticks.push(t0);
    return ticks;
  }

  function svgText(svg, x, y, text, attrs) {
    const t = svgEl("text", Object.assign({ x: x, y: y }, attrs || {}));
    t.textContent = text;
    svg.appendChild(t);
    return t;
  }

  function drawTrend() {
    const box = $("trend-chart");
    clear(box);
    trendGeom = null;
    if (!trendData.length) return;
    const W = Math.max(280, box.clientWidth || 700);
    const narrow = W < 480;
    // Right gutter for the end labels, sized to the longest label so they never sit on the plot.
    const lm = lastWith("margin_mid"), lr = lastWith("reported_margin"), lp = lastWith("pct_counted_est");
    const labLen = Math.max(lm ? named(lm.margin_mid).length : 0, lr ? named(lr.reported_margin).length : 0, 8);
    const m = { l: 40, r: Math.min(116, Math.ceil(labLen * (narrow ? 6.3 : 6.9)) + 12), t: 10 };
    const ph = narrow ? 200 : 260;           // margin panel
    const gap = 44, ph2 = narrow ? 56 : 70;  // turnout panel
    const top2 = m.t + ph + gap;
    const H = top2 + ph2 + 24;
    const pw = W - m.l - m.r;
    const t0 = trendData[0].ms, t1 = trendData[trendData.length - 1].ms, span = t1 - t0;
    const xOf = function (t) { return span > 0 ? m.l + (t - t0) / span * pw : m.l + pw - 4; };  // a lone point sits at the right, by its label
    let mx = 0;
    trendData.forEach(function (h) {
      ["margin_mid", "margin_lo95", "margin_hi95", "margin_lo50", "margin_hi50", "reported_margin"].forEach(function (k) { if (isNum(h[k])) mx = Math.max(mx, Math.abs(h[k])); });
    });
    const Y = Math.max(10, Math.ceil(mx / 10) * 10);
    const yOf = function (v) { return m.t + (Y - Math.max(-Y, Math.min(Y, v))) / (2 * Y) * ph; };
    const y2Of = function (p) { return top2 + (1 - Math.max(0, Math.min(100, p)) / 100) * ph2; };
    const svg = svgEl("svg", { viewBox: "0 0 " + W + " " + H, height: H, "aria-hidden": "true" });

    const tint = function (v) { return v > 0.05 ? "#1171B9" : (v < -0.05 ? "#C81E24" : "#1f2933"); };
    // Light gridlines; tick text coloured by side
    [-Y, -Y / 2, 0, Y / 2, Y].forEach(function (v) {
      if (v !== 0) svg.appendChild(svgEl("line", { x1: m.l, x2: W - m.r, y1: yOf(v), y2: yOf(v), stroke: "#e3e6ea", "stroke-width": 1 }));
      svgText(svg, m.l - 6, yOf(v) + 4, axisLabel(v), { "text-anchor": "end", style: "fill:" + tint(v) });
    });

    // Bands
    const band = function (lo, hi, fill, op) {
      runs([lo, hi]).forEach(function (r) {
        if (r.length === 1) {
          const h = r[0], x = xOf(h.ms);
          svg.appendChild(svgEl("rect", { x: x - 3, y: yOf(Math.max(h[lo], h[hi])), width: 6, height: Math.max(1, Math.abs(yOf(h[lo]) - yOf(h[hi]))), fill: fill, "fill-opacity": op }));
          return;
        }
        const up = r.map(function (h, i) { return (i ? "L" : "M") + xOf(h.ms).toFixed(1) + " " + yOf(h[hi]).toFixed(1); }).join(" ");
        const dn = r.slice().reverse().map(function (h) { return "L" + xOf(h.ms).toFixed(1) + " " + yOf(h[lo]).toFixed(1); }).join(" ");
        svg.appendChild(svgEl("path", { d: up + " " + dn + " Z", fill: fill, "fill-opacity": op }));
      });
    };
    band("margin_lo95", "margin_hi95", "#dfe2e6", 1);
    band("margin_lo50", "margin_hi50", "#b3bac2", 1);
    svg.appendChild(svgEl("line", { x1: m.l, x2: W - m.r, y1: yOf(0), y2: yOf(0), stroke: "#8a929c", "stroke-width": 1 }));

    // Lines
    const line = function (key, attrs) {
      runs([key]).forEach(function (r) {
        if (r.length < 2) return;
        const d = r.map(function (h, i) { return (i ? "L" : "M") + xOf(h.ms).toFixed(1) + " " + yOf(h[key]).toFixed(1); }).join(" ");
        svg.appendChild(svgEl("path", Object.assign({ d: d, fill: "none", "stroke-linejoin": "round" }, attrs)));
      });
    };
    line("reported_margin", { stroke: "#1f2933", "stroke-width": 1.75, "stroke-dasharray": "0.5 3.5", "stroke-linecap": "round" });
    line("margin_mid", { stroke: "#1f2933", "stroke-width": 2.25, "stroke-linecap": "round" });

    // Thin marker at the latest update
    const xNow = xOf(t1);
    svg.appendChild(svgEl("line", { x1: xNow, x2: xNow, y1: m.t, y2: top2 + ph2, stroke: "#aab1ba", "stroke-width": 1 }));

    // End labels in the right gutter: estimate (bold, coloured) and reported (lighter), two lines each
    const labels = [];
    if (lr) {
      svg.appendChild(svgEl("circle", { cx: xOf(lr.ms), cy: yOf(lr.reported_margin), r: 3, fill: "#fff", stroke: "#1f2933", "stroke-width": 1.5 }));
      labels.push({ y: yOf(lr.reported_margin), v: lr.reported_margin, main: named(lr.reported_margin), sub: "reported", bold: false });
    }
    if (lm) {
      svg.appendChild(svgEl("circle", { cx: xOf(lm.ms), cy: yOf(lm.margin_mid), r: 4, fill: "#1f2933", stroke: "#fff", "stroke-width": 1.5 }));
      labels.push({ y: yOf(lm.margin_mid), v: lm.margin_mid, main: named(lm.margin_mid), sub: "estimate", bold: true });
    }
    const LH = 28;                                   // height of one two-line label
    labels.forEach(function (L) { L.c = L.y; });
    if (labels.length === 2) {
      const a = labels[0].c <= labels[1].c ? labels[0] : labels[1], b = a === labels[0] ? labels[1] : labels[0];
      if (b.c - a.c < LH) { const mid = (a.c + b.c) / 2; a.c = mid - LH / 2; b.c = mid + LH / 2; }
      if (a.c < m.t + 8) { b.c += m.t + 8 - a.c; a.c = m.t + 8; }
      if (b.c > m.t + ph - 16) { a.c -= b.c - (m.t + ph - 16); b.c = m.t + ph - 16; }
    } else labels.forEach(function (L) { L.c = Math.max(m.t + 8, Math.min(m.t + ph - 16, L.c)); });
    const gx = W - m.r + 8;
    labels.forEach(function (L) {
      svgText(svg, gx, L.c + 2, L.main, { style: "fill:" + tint(L.v) + ";font-weight:" + (L.bold ? 700 : 400) + ";font-size:" + (narrow ? 11.5 : 12.5) + "px" });
      svgText(svg, gx, L.c + 15, L.sub, { style: "font-size:11px" });
    });

    // Turnout panel
    svgText(svg, m.l, top2 - 12, "Share of expected turnout reported", { style: "fill:#1f2933;font-weight:600;font-size:13px" });
    [0, 50, 100].forEach(function (p) {
      svg.appendChild(svgEl("line", { x1: m.l, x2: W - m.r, y1: y2Of(p), y2: y2Of(p), stroke: p === 0 ? "#aab1ba" : "#e3e6ea", "stroke-width": 1 }));
      svgText(svg, m.l - 6, y2Of(p) + 4, p + "%", { "text-anchor": "end" });
    });
    runs(["pct_counted_est"]).forEach(function (r) {
      let d = "M" + xOf(r[0].ms).toFixed(1) + " " + y2Of(0).toFixed(1) + " L" + xOf(r[0].ms).toFixed(1) + " " + y2Of(r[0].pct_counted_est).toFixed(1);
      let top = "M" + xOf(r[0].ms).toFixed(1) + " " + y2Of(r[0].pct_counted_est).toFixed(1);
      for (let i = 1; i < r.length; i++) {
        const seg = " H" + xOf(r[i].ms).toFixed(1) + " V" + y2Of(r[i].pct_counted_est).toFixed(1);
        d += seg; top += seg;
      }
      const xe = xOf(r[r.length - 1].ms);
      if (r.length === 1) { d += " H" + (xe + 3).toFixed(1); top += " H" + (xe + 3).toFixed(1); }
      d += " V" + y2Of(0).toFixed(1) + " Z";
      svg.appendChild(svgEl("path", { d: d, fill: "#7a838e", "fill-opacity": 0.3 }));
      svg.appendChild(svgEl("path", { d: top, fill: "none", stroke: "#56606c", "stroke-width": 1.5 }));
    });
    if (lp) svgText(svg, gx, Math.max(top2 + 4, y2Of(lp.pct_counted_est)) + 4, pctIn(lp.pct_counted_est), { class: "end" });

    // Time axis, under the turnout panel
    timeTicks(t0, t1, pw).forEach(function (t) {
      svg.appendChild(svgEl("line", { x1: xOf(t), x2: xOf(t), y1: top2 + ph2, y2: top2 + ph2 + 4, stroke: "#aab1ba", "stroke-width": 1 }));
      const xt = xOf(t);
      svgText(svg, xt, H - 6, clock(t), { "text-anchor": xt > W - m.r - 24 ? "end" : "middle" });
    });

    const cross = svgEl("line", { y1: m.t, y2: top2 + ph2, stroke: "#56606c", "stroke-width": 1, visibility: "hidden" });
    const dot = svgEl("circle", { r: 4, fill: "#1f2933", stroke: "#fff", "stroke-width": 2, visibility: "hidden" });
    svg.appendChild(cross);
    svg.appendChild(dot);
    box.appendChild(svg);
    const tip = document.createElement("div");
    tip.className = "tip";
    tip.hidden = true;
    box.appendChild(tip);
    trendGeom = { xOf: xOf, yOf: yOf, cross: cross, dot: dot, tip: tip, W: W, t0: t0, span: span, l: m.l, pw: pw };
    if (trendIndex !== null) showTrend(trendIndex);
  }

  function showTrend(i) {
    if (!trendGeom || !trendData[i]) return;
    trendIndex = i;
    const g = trendGeom, h = trendData[i], x = g.xOf(h.ms);
    g.cross.setAttribute("x1", x); g.cross.setAttribute("x2", x); g.cross.setAttribute("visibility", "visible");
    if (isNum(h.margin_mid)) {
      g.dot.setAttribute("cx", x); g.dot.setAttribute("cy", g.yOf(h.margin_mid)); g.dot.setAttribute("visibility", "visible");
    } else g.dot.setAttribute("visibility", "hidden");
    clear(g.tip);
    [[timeET(h.t), ""], [named(h.margin_mid), "estimate"],
     [isNum(h.margin_lo50) ? rangeText(h.margin_lo50, h.margin_hi50) : null, "50% of outcomes"],
     [isNum(h.margin_lo95) ? rangeText(h.margin_lo95, h.margin_hi95) : null, "95% of outcomes"],
     [isNum(h.reported_margin) ? named(h.reported_margin) : "No votes", "reported"],
     [isNum(h.pct_counted_est) ? pctIn(h.pct_counted_est) : null, "of expected turnout reported"]]
      .forEach(function (r) {
        if (r[0] === null) return;
        const line = document.createElement("div");
        const b = document.createElement("b"); b.textContent = r[0];
        const sp = document.createElement("span"); sp.textContent = r[1] ? " " + r[1] : "";
        line.appendChild(b); line.appendChild(sp);
        g.tip.appendChild(line);
      });
    g.tip.hidden = false;
    const tw = g.tip.offsetWidth;
    g.tip.style.left = (x + 12 + tw > g.W ? Math.max(0, x - 12 - tw) : x + 12) + "px";
  }

  function hideTrend() {
    trendIndex = null;
    if (!trendGeom) return;
    trendGeom.cross.setAttribute("visibility", "hidden");
    trendGeom.dot.setAttribute("visibility", "hidden");
    trendGeom.tip.hidden = true;
  }

  (function wireTrend() {
    const box = $("trend-chart");
    function nearest(ev) {
      if (!trendGeom || !trendData.length) return;
      const g = trendGeom;
      const px = ev.clientX - box.getBoundingClientRect().left;
      const t = g.span > 0 ? g.t0 + (px - g.l) / g.pw * g.span : g.t0;
      let lo = 0, hi = trendData.length - 1;
      while (hi - lo > 1) { const mid = (lo + hi) >> 1; if (trendData[mid].ms < t) lo = mid; else hi = mid; }
      showTrend(Math.abs(trendData[lo].ms - t) <= Math.abs(trendData[hi].ms - t) ? lo : hi);
    }
    box.addEventListener("pointermove", nearest);
    box.addEventListener("pointerdown", nearest);
    box.addEventListener("pointerleave", hideTrend);
    box.addEventListener("focus", function () {
      if (box.matches(":focus-visible") && trendData.length) showTrend(trendData.length - 1);
    });
    box.addEventListener("blur", hideTrend);
    box.addEventListener("keydown", function (ev) {
      if (!trendData.length) return;
      const n = trendData.length, cur = trendIndex === null ? n - 1 : trendIndex;
      let next = null;
      if (ev.key === "ArrowLeft") next = cur - 1;
      else if (ev.key === "ArrowRight") next = cur + 1;
      else if (ev.key === "Home") next = 0;
      else if (ev.key === "End") next = n - 1;
      else if (ev.key === "Escape") { hideTrend(); return; }
      if (next === null) return;
      ev.preventDefault();
      showTrend(Math.max(0, Math.min(n - 1, next)));
    });
    let lastW = 0;
    if (window.ResizeObserver) {
      new ResizeObserver(function (entries) {
        const w = entries[0].contentRect.width;
        if (Math.abs(w - lastW) > 1) { lastW = w; drawTrend(); }
      }).observe(box);
    }
  })();

  // Descriptions of the three sources. The 4.5 is CFG$prior_mid in needle_nc01/R/config.R (approved by ZH 2026-11-03).
  const SOURCES = [
    ["prior", "Starting estimate", "The pre-election starting point: Davis by 4.5 points, an adjusted average of four district polls since August. Three of the four were partisan, so the range around it is kept wide. See the method note."],
    ["model", "Model", "The model's projection of the votes not yet counted, from the results so far."],
    ["actual", "Counted votes", "Votes already counted."]
  ];

  function renderSources(s) {
    const box = $("src-list");
    clear(box);
    const src = s.sources && typeof s.sources === "object" ? s.sources : {};
    if (!SOURCES.some(function (r) { return isNum(src[r[0]]); })) {
      box.appendChild(legendText("p", "small", "Not available yet."));
      return;
    }
    SOURCES.forEach(function (r) {
      const v = src[r[0]];
      const rowEl = document.createElement("div");
      rowEl.className = "src-row";
      const text = document.createElement("div");
      text.className = "src-text";
      text.appendChild(legendText("h3", "", r[1]));
      text.appendChild(legendText("p", "", r[2]));
      rowEl.appendChild(text);
      const track = document.createElement("span");
      track.className = "bar-track";
      track.setAttribute("aria-hidden", "true");
      const fill = document.createElement("span");
      fill.className = "bar-fill";
      fill.style.width = (isNum(v) ? Math.max(0, Math.min(1, v)) * 100 : 0) + "%";
      track.appendChild(fill);
      rowEl.appendChild(track);
      const pv = isNum(v) ? (v > 0 && v < 0.005 ? "<1%" : (v < 1 && v > 0.995 ? ">99%" : Math.round(v * 100) + "%")) : NA;
      rowEl.appendChild(legendText("span", "src-pct", pv));
      box.appendChild(rowEl);
    });
  }

  /* ---------- who is ahead of the benchmark ---------- */
  const BENCH_DIMS = [
    ["Area", "By area"],
    ["2024 presidential result", "By 2024 presidential result"],
    ["Race", "By share of Black voters among early voters"],
    ["Age", "By share of voters 65 and older among early voters"]
  ];

  function renderGroups(s) {
    const box = $("bench-groups");
    clear(box);
    const list = arr(s.groups).filter(function (g) { return g && g.dimension; });
    let any = false;
    BENCH_DIMS.forEach(function (dim) {
      const rows = list.filter(function (g) { return g.dimension === dim[0]; });
      if (!rows.length) return;
      any = true;
      const wrap = document.createElement("div");
      wrap.appendChild(legendText("h3", "", dim[1]));
      const table = document.createElement("table");
      table.className = "bench-table";
      const thead = document.createElement("thead");
      const htr = document.createElement("tr");
      [["Group", ""], ["Leader margin", ""], ["Who is ahead of the benchmark?", "who"]].forEach(function (h) {
        const th = td(h[0], "th"); th.scope = "col"; if (h[1]) th.className = h[1]; htr.appendChild(th);
      });
      thead.appendChild(htr);
      table.appendChild(thead);
      const body = document.createElement("tbody");
      rows.forEach(function (g) {
        const tr = document.createElement("tr");
        const th = document.createElement("th");
        th.scope = "row";
        th.className = "grp";
        th.appendChild(document.createTextNode(g.group || NA));
        if (isNum(g.counties_reporting) && isNum(g.counties_total)) {
          th.appendChild(legendText("span", "sub", "Data from " + g.counties_reporting + " of " + g.counties_total + " counties"));
        }
        tr.appendChild(th);
        tr.appendChild(isNum(g.votes) && g.votes > 0 ? td(margin(g.leader_margin)) : legendText("td", "muted", "No votes"));
        const who = document.createElement("td");
        who.className = "who";
        const gap = isNum(g.vs_benchmark) ? Math.abs(g.vs_benchmark).toFixed(1) : null;
        let main;
        if ((g.status === "Davis" || g.status === "Buckhout") && gap !== null) {
          main = legendText("span", g.status === "Davis" ? "m-d" : "m-r", g.status + " by " + gap + " pts");
        } else if (g.status === "Davis" || g.status === "Buckhout") {
          main = legendText("span", g.status === "Davis" ? "m-d" : "m-r", g.status);
        } else if (g.status === "Neither") {
          main = legendText("span", "", "Neither candidate");
        } else {
          main = legendText("span", "muted", "Too early to tell");
        }
        who.appendChild(main);
        if (isNum(g.benchmark_margin)) who.appendChild(legendText("span", "sub", "Benchmark: " + margin(g.benchmark_margin)));
        tr.appendChild(who);
        body.appendChild(tr);
      });
      table.appendChild(body);
      const scroller = document.createElement("div");
      scroller.className = "table-scroll";
      scroller.tabIndex = 0;
      scroller.setAttribute("role", "region");
      scroller.setAttribute("aria-label", dim[1]);
      scroller.appendChild(table);
      wrap.appendChild(scroller);
      box.appendChild(wrap);
    });
    if (!any) box.appendChild(legendText("p", "small", "Not available yet."));
  }

  /* ---------- tables ---------- */
  function renderMethods(s) {
    const body = $("method-body");
    clear(body);
    const list = arr(s.by_method);
    if (!list.length) emptyRow(body, 5, "Not available yet.");
    list.forEach(function (m) {
      body.appendChild(row([m.method || NA, int(m.votes), int(m.expected_votes), margin(m.margin), margin(m.baseline_margin)]));
    });
  }

  let countyRows = [];
  const countySort = { key: "votes", dir: -1 };

  function countyValue(c, key) {
    if (key === "precincts") return isNum(c.precincts_reported) && c.precincts_total > 0 ? c.precincts_reported / c.precincts_total : null;
    return c[key];
  }

  function drawCounties() {
    const body = $("county-body");
    clear(body);
    if (!countyRows.length) emptyRow(body, 7, "Not available yet.");
    const key = countySort.key, dir = countySort.dir;
    countyRows.slice().sort(function (a, b) {
      const x = countyValue(a, key), y = countyValue(b, key);
      const xn = x === null || x === undefined, yn = y === null || y === undefined;
      if (xn || yn) return xn === yn ? String(a.county).localeCompare(String(b.county)) : (xn ? 1 : -1); // blanks always last
      if (typeof x === "string" || typeof y === "string") return dir * String(x).localeCompare(String(y));
      return dir * (x - y) || String(a.county).localeCompare(String(b.county));
    }).forEach(function (c) {
      const prec = isNum(c.precincts_reported) && isNum(c.precincts_total) ? c.precincts_reported + " of " + c.precincts_total : NA;
      body.appendChild(row([c.county ? titleCase(c.county) : NA, prec, int(c.votes), margin(c.margin), margin(c.house2024_margin), margin(c.baseline_margin), margin(c.swing)]));
    });
    document.querySelectorAll("#county-head th").forEach(function (th) {
      const on = th.dataset.key === key;
      th.setAttribute("aria-sort", on ? (dir > 0 ? "ascending" : "descending") : "none");
      th.querySelector(".arrow").textContent = on ? (dir > 0 ? "▲" : "▼") : "";
    });
  }

  document.querySelectorAll("#county-head th").forEach(function (th) {
    th.querySelector("button").addEventListener("click", function () {
      const k = th.dataset.key;
      if (countySort.key === k) countySort.dir = -countySort.dir;
      else { countySort.key = k; countySort.dir = k === "county" ? 1 : -1; }
      drawCounties();
    });
  });

  function renderEarly(s) {
    const e = s.early_electorate || {};
    $("early-meta").textContent = isNum(e.total)
      ? int(e.total) + " voters as of " + whenET(e.as_of) + "." : "";
    const box = $("early-groups");
    clear(box);
    let any = false;
    [["By party", e.by_party], ["By race", e.by_race], ["By age", e.by_age], ["By gender", e.by_gender]].forEach(function (g) {
      const list = arr(g[1]);
      if (!list.length) return;
      any = true;
      const wrap = document.createElement("div");
      const h = document.createElement("h3");
      h.textContent = g[0];
      wrap.appendChild(h);
      const table = document.createElement("table");
      const thead = document.createElement("thead");
      const htr = document.createElement("tr");
      ["Group", "Voters", "Share", "2024 share"].forEach(function (t) {
        const th = td(t, "th"); th.scope = "col"; htr.appendChild(th);
      });
      thead.appendChild(htr);
      table.appendChild(thead);
      const body = document.createElement("tbody");
      list.forEach(function (r) { body.appendChild(row([r.group || NA, int(r.n), share(r.share), share(r.share_2024)])); });
      table.appendChild(body);
      const scroller = document.createElement("div");
      scroller.className = "table-scroll";
      scroller.tabIndex = 0;
      scroller.setAttribute("role", "region");
      scroller.setAttribute("aria-label", g[0]);
      scroller.appendChild(table);
      wrap.appendChild(scroller);
      box.appendChild(wrap);
    });
    if (!any) {
      const p = document.createElement("p");
      p.className = "small";
      p.textContent = "Not available yet.";
      box.appendChild(p);
    }
  }

  /* ---------- what the trailing candidate needs ---------- */
  const pts1 = function (x) { return Math.abs(x).toFixed(1); };
  const roundVotes = function (x) {
    if (!isNum(x)) return NA;
    if (x < 100) return int(x);
    const step = x >= 10000 ? 1000 : (x >= 1000 ? 100 : 10);
    return int(Math.max(step, Math.round(x / step) * step));
  };
  // Margin on the remaining votes from the trailing candidate's side: "win by 3.1", "lose by 0.9".
  const winLose = function (x) {
    if (!isNum(x)) return NA;
    if (pts1(x) === "0.0") return "break even";
    return (x > 0 ? "win by " : "lose by ") + pts1(x);
  };
  const block = function (x) { return x && typeof x === "object" && x.available === true ? x : null; };

  function renderNeeds(s) {
    const t = block(s.trailing_needs);
    const plot = $("needs-plot"), axis = $("needs-axis");
    clear(plot); clear(axis);
    $("needs").hidden = true;
    $("needs-chart").hidden = true;
    if (!t) return;
    const hasLead = isNum(t.lead_votes) && t.lead_votes > 0;
    const who = hasLead && (t.trailer === "Davis" || t.trailer === "Buckhout") ? t.trailer : null;
    $("needs-title").textContent = who ? "What " + who + " needs" : "The votes still to count";
    const parts = [];
    if (who) parts.push(who + " trails by " + int(t.lead_votes) + (Math.round(t.lead_votes) === 1 ? " vote." : " votes."));
    else if (isNum(t.lead_votes)) parts.push("Davis and Buckhout are tied in the count.");
    const rem = t.remaining_votes_mid;
    if (isNum(rem) && rem >= 1) {
      parts.push("About " + roundVotes(rem) + (Math.round(rem) === 1 ? " vote remains" : " votes remain") +
        (isNum(t.remaining_votes_lo90) && isNum(t.remaining_votes_hi90) ? " (" + roundVotes(t.remaining_votes_lo90) + " to " + roundVotes(t.remaining_votes_hi90) + ")." : "."));
    } else if (isNum(rem)) {
      parts.push("The model expects no votes left to count.");
    }
    const need = t.needed_margin, exp = t.expected_margin_mid;
    let chart = false;
    if (who && t.needed_possible === false) {
      parts.push(who + " cannot catch up on the expected remaining votes: the lead is larger than the votes the model expects to be left.");
    } else if (who && isNum(need)) {
      let txt = who + " needs to win them by " + pts1(need) + " points";
      if (isNum(exp)) {
        txt += "; the model expects " + who + " to " + winLose(exp).replace(" by ", " them by ").replace("break even", "split them evenly");
        if (isNum(t.expected_margin_lo90) && isNum(t.expected_margin_hi90)) txt += " (range: " + winLose(t.expected_margin_lo90) + " to " + winLose(t.expected_margin_hi90) + ")";
        chart = true;
      }
      parts.push(txt + ".");
    }
    $("needs-text").textContent = parts.join(" ");
    $("needs").hidden = false;
    if (!chart) return;

    // Horizontal scale: trailer's margin on the remaining votes, in points.
    let mx = 0;
    [need, exp, t.expected_margin_lo90, t.expected_margin_hi90].forEach(function (v) { if (isNum(v)) mx = Math.max(mx, Math.abs(v)); });
    const D = Math.min(100, Math.max(20, Math.ceil(mx / 10) * 10));
    const pos = function (v) { return 50 + 50 * Math.max(-D, Math.min(D, v)) / D; };
    const add = function (cls, left, width) {
      const i = document.createElement("i");
      i.className = cls;
      i.style.left = left + "%";
      if (width !== undefined) i.style.width = Math.max(width, 0.6) + "%";
      plot.appendChild(i);
    };
    [-D / 2, D / 2].forEach(function (v) { add("grid", pos(v)); });
    add("zero", 50);
    if (isNum(t.expected_margin_lo90) && isNum(t.expected_margin_hi90)) {
      const a = Math.min(t.expected_margin_lo90, t.expected_margin_hi90), b = Math.max(t.expected_margin_lo90, t.expected_margin_hi90);
      add("band", pos(a), pos(b) - pos(a));
    }
    add("dot", pos(exp));
    add("need", pos(need));
    plot.title = $("needs-text").textContent;
    [[-D, "Lose by " + D, "first"], [0, "Even", "even"], [D, "Win by " + D, "last"]].forEach(function (a) {
      const sp = legendText("span", a[2], a[1]);
      sp.style.left = pos(a[0]) + "%";
      axis.appendChild(sp);
    });
    $("needs-caption").textContent = who + "'s margin on the votes still to be counted, in points.";
    $("needs-chart").hidden = false;
  }

  /* ---------- Davis v Cooper ---------- */
  const DVC_MIN_VOTES = 500;
  const signed = function (x) {
    if (!isNum(x)) return NA;
    const v = Math.abs(x).toFixed(1);
    return v === "0.0" ? "0.0" : (x > 0 ? "+" : "−") + v;
  };
  const leadText = function (x, a, b) {
    if (!isNum(x)) return a + ": " + NA;
    const v = pts1(x);
    if (v === "0.0") return a + " and " + b + " are tied";
    return a + (x > 0 ? " leads " : " trails ") + b + " by " + v + " points";
  };
  const houseVotes = function (n) { return int(n) + (Math.round(n) === 1 ? " House vote" : " House votes"); };

  function renderDvc(s) {
    const d = block(s.davis_v_cooper);
    const list = $("dvc-list"), body = $("dvc-body");
    clear(list); clear(body);
    $("dvc-few").textContent = "";
    $("dvc-chart").hidden = true;
    if (!d) { $("dvc-line").textContent = "Not available yet."; emptyRow(body, 5, "Not available yet."); return; }
    const dist = d.district || {};
    const g = dist.davis_minus_cooper;
    if (isNum(g)) {
      const v = pts1(g);
      $("dvc-line").textContent = (v === "0.0" ? "Davis is running even with Cooper on the same ballots." :
        "Davis is running " + v + " points " + (g > 0 ? "ahead of" : "behind") + " Cooper on the same ballots.") +
        (isNum(dist.davis_margin) && isNum(dist.cooper_margin)
          ? " " + leadText(dist.davis_margin, "Davis", "Buckhout") + " and " + leadText(dist.cooper_margin, "Cooper", "Whatley") + (isNum(dist.votes_house) ? ", on " + houseVotes(dist.votes_house) + "." : ".")
          : "");
    } else {
      $("dvc-line").textContent = "Not available yet.";
    }
    const counties = arr(d.by_county).filter(function (c) { return c && c.county; });
    const enough = function (c) { return isNum(c.votes_house) && c.votes_house >= DVC_MIN_VOTES && isNum(c.davis_minus_cooper); };
    const shown = counties.filter(enough).sort(function (a, b) { return b.davis_minus_cooper - a.davis_minus_cooper || String(a.county).localeCompare(String(b.county)); });
    const held = counties.filter(function (c) { return !enough(c); }).sort(function (a, b) { return String(a.county).localeCompare(String(b.county)); });

    // Table: district first, then counties in chart order, then held-back counties.
    if (isNum(g)) body.appendChild(row(["NC-1 total", int(dist.votes_house), margin(dist.davis_margin), margin(dist.cooper_margin), signed(g)]));
    shown.forEach(function (c) {
      body.appendChild(row([titleCase(c.county), int(c.votes_house), margin(c.davis_margin), margin(c.cooper_margin), signed(c.davis_minus_cooper)]));
    });
    held.forEach(function (c) {
      const tr = row([titleCase(c.county), int(c.votes_house)]);
      const few = legendText("td", "muted", isNum(c.votes_house) && c.votes_house > 0 ? "Too few votes" : "No votes yet");
      few.colSpan = 3;
      tr.appendChild(few);
      body.appendChild(tr);
    });
    if (!body.firstChild) emptyRow(body, 5, "Not available yet.");
    const fewc = held.filter(function (c) { return isNum(c.votes_house) && c.votes_house > 0; });
    if (fewc.length) $("dvc-few").textContent = "Too few votes to show (under " + int(DVC_MIN_VOTES) + " House votes): " + fewc.map(function (c) { return titleCase(c.county); }).join(", ") + ".";
    if (!shown.length) return;

    let mx = 0;
    shown.forEach(function (c) { mx = Math.max(mx, Math.abs(c.davis_minus_cooper)); });
    const D = Math.min(100, Math.max(5, Math.ceil(mx / 5) * 5));
    const pos = function (v) { return 50 + 50 * Math.max(-D, Math.min(D, v)) / D; };
    const ax = document.createElement("div");
    ax.className = "dvc-row axis";
    ax.appendChild(legendText("span", "", ""));
    const axis = document.createElement("div");
    axis.className = "rp-axis";
    [[-D, "Cooper ahead by " + D, "first"], [0, "Same", "even"], [D, "Davis ahead by " + D, "last"]].forEach(function (a) {
      const sp = legendText("span", a[2], a[1]);
      sp.style.left = pos(a[0]) + "%";
      axis.appendChild(sp);
    });
    ax.appendChild(axis);
    ax.appendChild(legendText("span", "val", "Pts"));
    list.appendChild(ax);
    shown.forEach(function (c) {
      const r = document.createElement("div");
      r.className = "dvc-row";
      const name = titleCase(c.county);
      const x = c.davis_minus_cooper;
      r.title = name + ": " + (pts1(x) === "0.0" ? "Davis and Cooper even" : signed(x) + " points, " + (x > 0 ? "Davis ahead" : "Cooper ahead")) +
        ". " + leadText(c.davis_margin, "Davis", "Buckhout") + "; " + leadText(c.cooper_margin, "Cooper", "Whatley") + "; " + houseVotes(c.votes_house) + ".";
      r.appendChild(legendText("span", "", name));
      const bar = document.createElement("div");
      bar.className = "dvc-bar";
      const mk = function (cls, left, width) {
        const i = document.createElement("i");
        i.className = cls;
        i.style.left = left + "%";
        if (width !== undefined) i.style.width = Math.max(width, 0.6) + "%";
        bar.appendChild(i);
      };
      [-D / 2, D / 2].forEach(function (v) { mk("grid", pos(v)); });
      mk(x >= 0 ? "pos" : "neg", Math.min(pos(x), 50), Math.abs(pos(x) - 50));
      mk("zero", 50);
      r.appendChild(bar);
      r.appendChild(legendText("span", "val", signed(x)));
      list.appendChild(r);
    });
    $("dvc-chart").hidden = false;
  }

  /* ---------- the Senate race on the old and new lines ---------- */
  const RD_MIN_SHARE = 0.10;
  const oldNew = function (x, who, verb) {
    if (!isNum(x)) return null;
    const v = pts1(x);
