    if (v === "0.0") return who + " margin " + verb + " the same on both sets of lines";
    return who + " margin " + verb + " " + v + " points " + (x > 0 ? "better" : "worse") + " on the old lines than on the new";
  };

  function renderRedistrict(s) {
    const r = block(s.redistricting);
    const body = $("rd-body");
    clear(body);
    $("rd-gap").textContent = "";
    $("rd-missing").textContent = "";
    $("rd-note").hidden = true;
    $("rd-table-wrap").hidden = true;
    if (!r) { $("rd-status").textContent = "Not available yet."; return; }
    const o = r.old_lines || {}, n = r.new_lines || {};
    if (typeof r.old_lines_unavailable_reason === "string" && r.old_lines_unavailable_reason) {
      $("rd-status").textContent = "The old-lines comparison needs the state's statewide results file, which is not available right now.";
      return;
    }
    const ready = isNum(o.counted_share) && isNum(n.counted_share) && o.counted_share >= RD_MIN_SHARE && n.counted_share >= RD_MIN_SHARE;
    if (!ready) {
      $("rd-status").textContent = "Too early. This waits until votes equal to at least 10% of the 2024 presidential vote are counted on both sets of lines" +
        (isNum(o.counted_share) && isNum(n.counted_share) ? " (now " + share(o.counted_share) + " on the old lines and " + share(n.counted_share) + " on the new)." : ".");
      return;
    }
    $("rd-status").textContent = "";
    $("rd-note").hidden = r.low_match_flag !== true;
    [["Old lines (2024 map)", o], ["New lines (2025 map)", n]].forEach(function (x) {
      const L = x[1];
      const tr = row(["", int(L.counted_votes), share(L.counted_share), margin(L.senate_margin), margin(L.pres2024_margin_counted), margin(L.pres2024_margin)]);
      const th = tr.firstChild;
      th.textContent = x[0];
      if (isNum(L.counties_total)) th.appendChild(legendText("span", "muted", ", " + L.counties_total + " counties"));
      body.appendChild(tr);
    });
    $("rd-table-wrap").hidden = false;
    const gap = r.gap || {};
    const a = oldNew(gap.senate_old_minus_new, "Cooper's", "is"), b = oldNew(gap.pres2024_counted_old_minus_new, "Harris's", "was");
    const bits = [];
    if (a) bits.push("On the votes counted so far, " + a + ".");
    if (b) bits.push("On the same votes in 2024, " + b + (isNum(gap.pres2024_old_minus_new) ? " (" + (pts1(gap.pres2024_old_minus_new) === "0.0" ? "the same" : pts1(gap.pres2024_old_minus_new) + " points " + (gap.pres2024_old_minus_new > 0 ? "better" : "worse")) + " on all votes)." : "."));
    $("rd-gap").textContent = bits.join(" ");
    const miss = [];
    [["old", o], ["new", n]].forEach(function (x) {
      const m = arr(x[1].counties_missing).map(function (c) { return titleCase(c && typeof c === "object" ? c.county || "" : c); }).filter(Boolean);
      if (m.length) miss.push("Not yet reporting on the " + x[0] + " lines: " + m.join(", ") + ".");
    });
    $("rd-missing").textContent = miss.join(" ");
  }

  /* ---------- state and polling ---------- */
  let lastGood = null;
  let lastText = null;

  function renderAll(s) {
    // One malformed section must not take the rest of the page down on the night.
    [renderHead, renderDial, renderStats, renderNeeds, renderCount, renderMap, renderEstimates, renderDvc, renderTrend, renderSources, renderGroups, renderRedistrict, renderHistoryData, renderMethods, function (d) {
      countyRows = arr(d.by_county);
      drawCounties();
    }, renderEarly].forEach(function (f) {
      try { f(s); } catch (err) { console.error("needle: section failed", err); }
    });
  }

  function setNotice(text) {
    $("notice").hidden = !text;
    $("notice").textContent = text || "";
  }

  function freshnessNotice(s) {
    if (s.status === "counting" && validDate(s.updated_at) && Date.now() - Date.parse(s.updated_at) > PAGE_STALE_MS) {
      return "This data file has not refreshed since " + whenET(s.updated_at) + ". The numbers may be out of date.";
    }
    return "";
  }

  function onFailure() {
    if (lastGood) {
      setNotice("Could not load new data at " + clock(Date.now()) + " ET. Showing the last data received, from " + whenET(lastGood.updated_at) + ".");
    } else {
      const closed = Date.now() >= POLLS_CLOSE;
      if (closed) $("state").textContent = "Polls closed at 7:30 pm ET";
      setNotice(closed
        ? "Live data is not available yet. This page will fill in when the data file loads."
        : "Live data is not available yet. This page will fill in on election night, after polls close at 7:30 pm ET.");
    }
  }

  async function poll() {
    const ctl = new AbortController();
    const timer = setTimeout(function () { ctl.abort(); }, FETCH_TIMEOUT_MS);
    try {
      const res = await fetch(url, { signal: ctl.signal });
      if (!res.ok) throw new Error("HTTP " + res.status);
      const text = await res.text();
      const s = JSON.parse(text);
      if (!s || typeof s !== "object" || !s.status) throw new Error("not a state file");
      // A CDN edge can hand back an older copy. Older data never replaces newer data.
      const older = lastGood && validDate(s.updated_at) && validDate(lastGood.updated_at) &&
        Date.parse(s.updated_at) < Date.parse(lastGood.updated_at);
      if (!older && text !== lastText) {
        lastText = text;
        lastGood = s;
        renderAll(s);
      }
      setNotice(freshnessNotice(lastGood));
    } catch (err) {
      console.warn("needle: fetch failed", err);
      onFailure();
    } finally {
      clearTimeout(timer);
      setTimeout(poll, POLL_MS);
    }
  }

  // Page before any data arrives: candidate names and empty tables, no needle.
  renderCount({});
  renderMap({});
  renderMethods({});
  drawCounties();
  renderEarly({});
  renderHistoryData({});
  [renderEstimates, renderTrend, renderSources, renderGroups, renderNeeds, renderDvc, renderRedistrict].forEach(function (f) {
    try { f({}); } catch (err) { console.error("needle: section failed", err); }
  });
  poll();
})();
</script>
